entities.summary: Fred Oelßner was a German communist politician, economist and a leading political figure in the German Democratic Republic. He served as secretary of several departments of the ruling Socialist Unity Party of Germany (SED), specializing in cultural and academic matters.

entities.summary: Fred Oelßner was a German communist politician, economist and a leading political figure in the German Democratic Republic. He served as secretary of several departments of the ruling Socialist Unity Party of Germany (SED), specializing in cultural and academic matters.
